Question Choices: Fill: A line is made by placing 8 unit lengths end to end. The length of the line is __ units.
Hints: Count equal units touching end to end with no gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Eight equal unit lengths end to end give 8×1=8 units of length.

Question Choices: Fill: A rectangle is fully covered by 12 unit squares. The area of the rectangle is __ square units.
Hints: Count unit squares covering the shape with no gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Twelve unit squares covering without gaps or overlaps give 12 square units of area.

Question Choices: Select which measurement tells how much distance there is between two points in 1 dimension? ~~Length | Area | Volume~~
Solution: Length measures distance along one dimension. Area measures covering in two dimensions, and volume space in three.

Question Choices: Two boxes are fully filled with unit cubes. Box A has 24 unit cubes. Box B has 30 unit cubes. Which box has the greater volume?
Hints: Compare counts only when both boxes use the same-size cubes.
Solution: BoxA contains 24 unit cubes and BoxB 30 of the same unit cubes. Since 30>24, BoxB has the greater volume.

Question Choices: A shipping crate is packed tightly with 15 large storage blocks. If each block has a volume of 3 cubic feet, what is the total volume of the crate? __ cubic feet
Hints: Multiply the number of blocks by the volume of one block.
Solution: 15 blocks × 3 cubic feet per block = 45 cubic feet. Count every block once; these blocks fill the solid without gaps.
